  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Lead AI Engineer",
  "description": "BorederlessHR is a tech firm based in canada. They partner with different businesses in North America to recruit top tech African talent for available roles on a full time basis.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Lead AI Engineer

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: MD

Job Summary


	This job is a build role. It is not IT support, and it is not a digital transformation strategy role. In this job you will design, architect and deploy the digital infrastructure and AI systems that let a lean HoldCo team govern multiple subsidiaries with institutional precision.
	The company has a clear position: a complete specification handed to the best available AI tools produces a bespoke, company-owned system faster and more cheaply than configuring and licensing a commercial one.
	You will be expected to build that way. What will be assessed is whether you can specify well and hold quality to a high standard.


What You Will Do
Build and Deploy:


	Design, architect and deploy production-grade AI systems, including the MD Command Centre, Meeting Intelligence Engine, Portfolio Intelligence Dashboard, Agentic Recruitment System and other systems in the company&#39;s Product &amp; Systems Register
	Develop the company&#39;s AI institutional core: the context layer, advanced meeting intelligence, portfolio dashboard and agent layer
	Build full-stack applications across frontend, backend, database and deployment
	Implement RAG, embeddings, vector stores and agentic workflows, with outputs grounded and sources cited
	Build for model portability so the company can change AI providers without rebuilding its products


Specify and Agree:


	Turn business needs into system specifications by engaging users, validating requirements and getting written agreement before development
	Design interfaces and workflows, and obtain MD approval before development begins
	Test with real company data, including edge cases and failure scenarios, before anything goes live


Govern and Secure:


	Build and maintain the company&#39;s Microsoft 365 environment and governance (Entra ID, SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, Intune)
	Own the software layer of identity and access management
	Specify the physical infrastructure your software needs (readers, servers, network, power); Administration procures, installs and maintains it
	Apply Nigerian data protection requirements (NDPR) from the design stage


Deliver and Embed:


	Make sure every system meets the company&#39;s definition of &quot;finished&quot;: reliable, usable, documented, with clear failure handling and real user adoption
	Drive organisational change so employees actually move from existing processes to the new systems
	Produce READMEs, architecture documents and runbooks for every system
	Maintain the Product &amp; Systems Register and support the quarterly confirmation of the build sequence
	Monitor system operating costs and keep documented records of technology spend
	Deliver two substantive progress updates each week and a monthly one-page scorecard to the Office of the MD
	Raise proposed changes or concerns about priorities in writing, in line with the MD&#39;s agreed sequence
	Support subsidiary digital launch templates and the wider digital infrastructure across the portfolio


What success looks like


	By Day 90: ten live, production-grade, AI-powered systems deployed
	By end of Year 1: the institutional core of the company&#39;s AI suite built, every subsidiary given a digital launch template, and the company positioned as one of the most digitally sophisticated holding companies in Nigeria


Requirements
Essential:


	Bachelor&#39;sDegree in a relevant or related field
	Experience building so the AI provider can be swapped without a rebuild
	Shipped production systems that real people use to do real work, not prototypes or proofs of concept
	Designed and shipped at least one system built on an AI API (beyond using a coding assistant)
	Built at least one agentic system that acts autonomously without per-request user input
	Full-stack capability: React/Next.js, Node.js or Python, PostgreSQL or equivalent, and deployment
	Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings and vector stores, and the judgment to ground and cite answers
	Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance (Entra ID, SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, Intune)
	Understanding of Nigerian data protection requirements (NDPR)
	Ability to take a brief, architect a solution, build it and deploy it without a team


Strong advantage:


	Experience running or fine-tuning open-weight models on owned infrastructure. The company intends to move sensitive inference to company-controlled hardware in Nigeria over time.


Who You Are:


	Disciplined. You document as you build, write READMEs a stranger could follow, and never push an undocumented system to production.
	A system designer. You have an eye for detail and know that inconsistent table borders and a default blue submit button are a brand liability. Your interfaces feel effortless.
	Comfortable with ambiguity. There are no legacy systems here, only blank canvases, and that energises you.
	A change-maker. You can get an organisation to change how it works, which is the part most builders underestimate.


Why This Role


	Salary: N850,000 Monthly, gross upon resumption and reviewed to N1,200,000 after probation period.
	Build the digital foundation of a company from scratch, with real ownership and no legacy constraints
	Direct access to the Managing Director
	Your systems will shape how an entire portfolio of businesses operates.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and application to: amy4recruitment@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

	Compile and analyzes body fluids, tissue, and other substances to determine normal or abnormal findings.

	Identify and communicate abnormal results by alerting supervisory personnel, the patient, physician, or nurse.
